about: Surgical discharge and the first OxyNorm supply for knee replacement pain are recorded on 23 January 2026. Supplies recur every 28 days and continue beyond 23 April, the three-month boundary.
possible finding: the record holds no line about a hospital stay or surgery. OxyNorm (oxycodone), by brand name only, is supplied every 28 days for seven months from 26 January 2026.

Discharge from hospital after surgery is recorded on 5 February 2026 and OxyNorm (oxycodone) is supplied on 5 and 26 February and 19 March 2026, then stops, so there is no opioid supply more than 3 months after discharge.
